name: jalco-drop
description: A file, paste and screen-recording host on one Cloudflare Worker and an R2 bucket.

scripts.build: esbuild client/grain.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=public/grain.js && esbuild client/forms.js --minify --outfile=public/js/forms.js && esbuild client/islands.tsx --bundle --minify --format=esm --splitting --outdir=public/js --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --jsx=automatic && tailwindcss -i src/styles.css -o public/style.css --minify
scripts.build:node: npm run build && esbuild src/node.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --jsx=automatic --external:puppeteer-core --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test:node: npm run build:node && SMOKE_TARGET=node bash test/smoke.sh
